rows.grounds: ablative of cause/source; compound lākṣā (lac) + homa (oblation)
optative expressing potential result of the rite
describes the recipient; compound dāridrya (poverty) + bhaya (fear) + pīḍita (afflicted)

items.question: Can a lac oblation bestow kingship upon a person tormented by poverty and fear?
premises: A lac oblation is performed as a ritual act.
The performer is afflicted by poverty and fear.
Such an oblation can yield the attainment of kingship.
items.inference: Therefore, one afflicted by poverty and fear may obtain kingship through a lac oblation.
items.plain_english: Through an oblation of lac, a person tormented by poverty and fear may obtain a kingdom.
